method.method_draft: First read the residual plot: the residuals are strongly positive at the smallest fitted values, mostly negative in the middle fitted-value range, and positive again at the largest fitted values, forming a curved/U-shaped pattern rather than random scatter around zero. Read the question text as asking which transformation would better fit the dataset based on this residual pattern. Apply the residual-diagnosis rule that a curved residual pattern indicates nonlinearity, and for this type of concave/curved relationship in the response, a root transformation is the appropriate corrective transformation. Conclude that the root transformation should be used.

method.model_answer: The root transformation should be used.
